title: The Drosophila RNA binding protein Hrp48 binds a specific RNA sequence of the msl-2 mRNA 3’ UTR to regulate translation
authors: Andrea Lomoschitz; Julia Meyer; Tanit Guitart; Miroslav Krepl; Karine Lapouge; Clara Hayn; Kristian Schweimer; Bernd Simon; Jiří Šponer; Fátima Gebauer; Janosch Hennig
one_liner_zh: 该文研究RNA结合蛋白Hrp48与msl-2 mRNA 3'UTR的RNA序列结合，虽涉及分子动力学模拟，但对象为蛋白-RNA互作而非蛋白-DNA，且非TF-DNA体系，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Repression of msl-2 mRNA translation is essential for viability of Drosophila melanogaster females to prevent hypertranscription of both X chromosomes. This translational control event is coordinated by the female-specific protein Sex-lethal (Sxl) which recruits the RNA binding proteins Unr and Hrp48 to the 3’ untranslated region (UTR) of the msl-2 transcript and represses translation initiation. The mechanism exerted by Hrp48 during translation repression and its interaction with msl-2 are not well understood. Here we investigate the RNA binding specificity and affinity of the tandem RNA recognition motifs of Hrp48. Using NMR spectroscopy, molecular dynamics simulations and isothermal titration calorimetry, we identified the exact region of msl-2 3’ UTR recognized by Hrp48. Additional biophysical experiments and translation assays give further insights into complex formation of Hrp48, Unr, Sxl and RNA. Our results show that Hrp48 binds independent of Sxl and Unr downstream of the E and F binding sites of Sxl and Unr to msl-2 .
abstract_zh: 抑制msl-2 mRNA翻译对于果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）雌性个体的生存能力至关重要，以防止两条X染色体的过度转录。这一翻译控制事件由雌性特异性蛋白Sex-lethal（Sxl）协调，该蛋白招募RNA结合蛋白Unr和Hrp48至msl-2转录本的3‘非翻译区（UTR），并抑制翻译起始。Hrp48在翻译抑制过程中所发挥的机制及其与msl-2的相互作用尚不完全清楚。在此，我们研究了Hrp48串联RNA识别基序的RNA结合特异性和亲和力。利用核磁共振波谱（NMR spectroscopy）、分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟和等温滴定量热法（isothermal titration calorimetry），我们确定了Hrp48识别的msl-2 3’ UTR精确区域。额外的生物物理实验和翻译实验进一步揭示了Hrp48、Unr、Sxl与RNA复合物形成的细节。我们的结果表明，Hrp48在Sxl和Unr的E和F结合位点下游，独立于Sxl和Unr结合至msl-2。
